description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics covered in a dataset used for AI/NLP research, specifically related to the evaluation of attribution by large language models. The chart contains ten slices representing different subject categories. The largest slice, labeled “Business,” is blue and accounts for 24.3% of the total. “Econ. & Fin.” is represented by a reddish-orange slice at 18.4%, followed by “Game&Anime” in a light purple color at 8.2%, and “History” in a dark orange color at 8.2%. “Law” is shown as a light blue slice at 5.1%, while “Science” is a slightly darker blue at 6.7%. “Med & Health” is represented by a yellow slice at 6.7%, and “Geography” is a green slice at 2.7%. “Math” is a light green slice at 1.2%, and finally, “Pet & Animal” is a pink slice at 5.5%, and “Daily Life” is a red slice at 7.1%. The chart includes a legend listing each category and its corresponding color, and percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
